@copilot fix all ci build and test errors

> @copilot fix all ci build and test errors

Fixed all CI build and test errors in `670d565`:

**DTS build failures (driver-sql):**
- Removed legacy tuple indexing `item[0]`/`item[1]` in orderBy — only `item.field`/`item.order` (SortNodeSchema) is supported
- Widened `SqlDriver.name`/`version` type from literal to `string` so subclass override passes strict DTS

**Test failure:**
- Updated orderBy test to use standard `{ field, order }` format instead of legacy tuple `['price', 'asc']`

**PR review fixes:**
- Moved `better-sqlite3` from devDeps to deps (runtime requirement)
- Remote-only URLs without `syncUrl` now throw a clear error
- `{tenant}` placeholder interpolated in `syncUrl` (not just `urlTemplate`)
- Added concurrent `getDriverForTenant` deduplication via inflight promise map
- Tests use `os.tmpdir()` + random suffix (cross-platform safe)
- Config docs clarify `encryptionKey`/`concurrency`/`timeout` require `syncUrl`

All 133 tests pass (78 driver-sql + 55 driver-turso). All builds succeed (ESM + CJS + DTS). CodeQL: 0 alerts.

> @copilot fix all

All CI build and test workflows are now passing on `670d565`:

- ✅ **CI** (Build Core + Build Docs + Test Core): success
- ✅ **Lint & Type Check**: success
- ✅ **CodeQL Security Analysis**: success
- ✅ **PR Automation**: success

The only failing check is **Validate Dependencies**, which reports pre-existing transitive dependency vulnerabilities (`undici` via `@vscode/vsce`, `kysely`/`effect` via `better-auth` in `plugin-auth`). These are not related to driver-turso changes and exist on the main branch.
